description: Parse one User-Agent string. Returns browser, engine, OS, device type and CPU (ua-parser-js 1.0.41), and whether it is a known bot, search crawler, AI crawler (with its AI purpose) or an AI agent acting for a user (is_ai_agent, ai_agent_kind fetch | browsing), plus the bot name, operator, robots.txt token and operator docs link from a curated list of 151 bots (list 2026-10-08). verified is always false: the User-Agent is self-reported and UAParse does no IP or reverse-DNS checks. Read-only, no network lookups. Same engine and limits as the UAParse JSON API (POST /v1/parse); each call is one lookup. UAParse is independent and not affiliated with Meta, OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, Amazon, Perplexity or Mistral AI.

include_raw.description: Also return the full POST /v1/parse JSON in structuredContent.raw. Larger output.

ua.description: The User-Agent string to parse, exactly as sent in the User-Agent header.

name: parse_user_agent

bot.description: Present when is_bot is true. Fields that are unknown are omitted.

type.description: desktop, mobile, tablet, smarttv, console, wearable, xr, embedded, bot or unknown

is_ai_agent.description: true only for User-Agents the operator documents as acting live for an individual user

raw.description: Full POST /v1/parse response (only when include_raw is true)

ua.description: The parsed User-Agent (clipped to 300 characters; see ua_length)

title: Parse a User-Agent (browser, OS, device, bot / AI crawler / AI agent)
